description: Initial draft preparation stage where the institution fills statutory data, uploads land/infrastructure documents, and compiles mandatory evidence.
aphClauseCitation: APH 2024-2027 Chapter I Cl. 1.3 & Chapter II Cl. 2.1

entryPrerequisites.description: Applicant user must belong to a verified institution entity with valid email and phone verification.

validationRules: All mandatory institutional and land fields must be filled
100% of mandatory document types must have uploaded valid files
Processing fee payment transaction must be confirmed
Applicant digital declaration must be signed

timePolicy.description: Draft must be completed within portal submission window specified in annual calendar.

exitConditions.description: Application transitioned to SUBMITTED state with cryptographic digest and confirmation receipt issued.
verificationCriteria: Mandatory documents count matches template requirement
